0.name: Computing & mathematics
0.rationale: Centroid-near passages describe computer organization, discrete mathematics and numerical analysis; characteristic terms include data, algorithms, models and programming. This cluster also includes quantitative methods outside computing departments.

1.name: University & student life
1.rationale: Representative passages discuss the university mission, campus programs, international student services and student clubs. University, students, activities and opportunities characterize this broad institutional and community theme.

2.name: Language, writing & practice
2.rationale: Chinese language, academic writing and communication courses dominate the representative passages. Terms such as skills, writing, language and learn reflect skill-building; the cluster also contains practical arts, media and physical-education courses.

3.name: Academic status & conduct
3.rationale: Representatives concern withdrawal, incomplete grades, academic probation and student status. Academic, grade, leave and probation support a policy label; disciplinary procedures and conduct are also included.

4.name: History, culture & politics
4.rationale: Representative texts discuss world history, empire, modern China and global cultural studies. Characteristic terms include China, history, political, cultural and war, spanning several humanities and social-science subjects.

5.name: Society, health & policy
5.rationale: Representative passages describe policy analysis, social research, governance, ethics and environmental regulation. Health, social, policy, human and environmental indicate a mixed applied social and public-policy theme.

6.name: Natural & molecular science
6.rationale: Representatives cover biophysics, physical chemistry, molecular structures and biogeochemistry. Chemistry, molecular, materials, biological and physics distinguish this scientific cluster from the quantitative-computing cluster.

7.name: Credits & degree requirements
7.rationale: Representative paragraphs explain precollege credit, transfer rules and graduation credit limits. Credits, requirements, courses and taken characterize degree planning and credit eligibility.
